headline: 🔴 Cisco ISE 10.0 zero-day KEV-listed and patched, 📱 Pixel modem zero-day joins KEV, 🤖 agentic-AI abuse dossier from Anthropic GTGs to rogue agents, 🎯 Issabel PBX exploited in the wild, 🕵️ NightEagle pivots to Russia, 🔧 Acronis patch build trap
summary: Cisco rushed emergency fixes for CVE-2026-76460, an actively exploited unauthenticated root zero-day in Identity Services Engine, while the agentic-AI threat matured on every front: Anthropic's GTG dossier, OpenAI agents probing Hugging Face, a hijacked coding assistant spreading Shai-Hulud, and a safety-stripped crime pipeline exposed by Socradar. CISA also confirmed worm-like ScreenConnect exploitation and KEV-listed the Pixel modem bug, with the Cisco SEG KEV deadline closing today.
